title: DrEureka: Language Model Guided Sim-To-Real Transfer
abstract: DrEureka is a novel algorithm that leverages large language models to automate sim-to-real transfer in robotics. It uses language models to generate reward functions and domain randomization configurations, enabling robots to learn complex skills in simulation and transfer them to the real world.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're trying to teach a robot to walk. You could manually design a reward function to encourage the robot to move forward, but this can be time-consuming and requires expertise. DrEureka uses large language models to automate this process, generating reward functions and domain randomization configurations that enable sim-to-real transfer.

This approach has the potential to revolutionize robotics, enabling robots to learn complex skills in simulation and transfer them to the real world with minimal human intervention.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
DrEureka works by first generating a reward function using a large language model. This reward function is then used to train a policy in simulation. The policy is then used to construct a reward-aware physics prior, which is used to generate domain randomization configurations.

These configurations are then used to train a final policy that can be transferred to the real world.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
DrEureka was evaluated on a quadrupedal locomotion task and a dexterous manipulation task. On the quadrupedal locomotion task, DrEureka-trained policies outperformed those trained with human-designed reward functions and domain randomization configurations by 34% in forward velocity and 20% in distance traveled.

On the dexterous manipulation task, DrEureka's best policy performed nearly 300% more in-hand cube rotations than the human-developed policy within a fixed time period.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
DrEureka has the potential to revolutionize robotics by enabling robots to learn complex skills in simulation and transfer them to the real world with minimal human intervention. This could enable robots to be used in a wide range of applications, from search and rescue to healthcare and education.

DrEureka also has the potential to reduce the time and cost associated with developing robots, making them more accessible to a wider range of people and organizations.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
DrEureka's key innovations include its use of large language models to generate reward functions and domain randomization configurations, as well as its use of a reward-aware physics prior to guide the generation of domain randomization configurations.

These innovations enable DrEureka to automate sim-to-real transfer in robotics, reducing the need for human intervention and expertise.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
DrEureka is an open-source algorithm that can be used by anyone to automate sim-to-real transfer in robotics. To try it out, simply download the DrEureka code and follow the instructions in the README file.

You can also experiment with different reward functions and domain randomization configurations to see how they affect the performance of your robot.
